page.title: Credits & Referral Program
page.description: How credits work & the referral program
page.body:
Understanding PropertyList Credits:


While listing and sharing properties is completely free, PropertyList is much more than a basic MLS & CRM. We operate on a flexible, pay-as-you-go credit system that allows you to unlock premium tools - such as featuring your listings, accessing advanced AI CRM utilities, and deploying strategic marketing options designed to maximise your exposure and generate direct leads.
